meaning: M94's catalogued objects as dots on its photograph's disc: globular cluster candidates. Old objects near the centre can sit in the bulge.

banks.basis: Presentation choice: a dot is drawn only where the photograph is, inside the image layers' 5.862 kpc support radius (recipe.json).

colorTowardWhiteBasis: Presentation choice: the Milky Way dots' value (milky-way/source/local-3kpc/merge.json), so both galaxies' dots read as the same tints of starlight.
colorGammaBasis: Presentation choice: the Milky Way dots' value (milky-way/source/local-3kpc/merge.json), picked there from three renders over its backing.
